# zhi2-mobile-query-h5-c
Suzhou housing flood-control C-end mobile query H5 using uni-app + Vue3, GitLab `suzhufang-fe/zhi2-mobile-query-h5-c`, branch `dev`, local path `D:\repository\苏住房防汛C端`.

## Pages And Features
- `home/index.vue` (`.scroll-tabs` + `BottomNav`): 2026-11-04 C-end information feed with carousel/todos/learning corner/news list; 2026-11-14 skeleton/mapping set banner to API title/image with brand-text fallback when empty, todos to home task summary preserving source/date/category, and list to C-end API; pushed `fix/home-visual-20261114` (`a8f6c97652f4ae242135198bc2e3e335f73b527d`); bottom five items only map "我的" to "个人中心".
- 2026-11-25 ZenTao 6955 removed MOCK, distinguished B-end display, and connected real data; 2026-11-25 ZenTao 6968 showed the G-end rescue detail operation bar (immediate accept/report/progress feedback/completion) when roles exclude `wyqy`/`wyqygly`; concurrent session 43f282f fixed `detail.vue` and real screenshot passed; accept POST was not persisted and ticket stayed `status=1`.
- `mine/index.vue`: `.user-card` blue gradient, `.menu-card` white, `.mine-body` skeleton; data assembled by `portalData.ts fetchMine`. `data/index.vue`: static `ref-assets.ts` design DOM `REF_SEC0~REF_SEC5` is auto-generated, do not hand-edit; area labels/metrics were previously hardcoded, now only unique title text is bound (area/area size/enterprise count); detail subgrid and property assessment remain design drafts because APIs are missing.
- `project-check/form/index.vue`: ZenTao 6931 evaluation level selector was uncommented and passes level (3 frontend files uncommitted; local draft level-switch reload issue; `startCheck` passes level); backend root cause/commit/dual acceptance are in "ZenTao bug 6931 evaluation level transmission".
- 2026-11-27 ZenTao 7034: rescue workorder list refresh was fixed by moving list loading from `onLoad` to `onShow` in `src/pages/rescue-workorder/index.vue`; commit `fca4df7e` pushed `dev`; resolved/fixed with image fileID 24710; see "ZenTao bug 7034".

## Login And Requirements
- Login: `useFloodStore().login` calls `/v2.0/security/auth/login` returning `nickName/userName/userId/phone/roles`; captcha placeholder is "请输入图形验证码"; token key `flood-token-v1` is set in `request.ts`, user key `flood-login-user-v1` stores roles/roleKeys/deptId; injecting both keys simulates login.
- 2026-11-27T07:44:25+08:00 audit marked memory valid: `request.ts` lines 175/187 hit `flood-token-v1`/`flood-login-user-v1`, and `scroll-tabs` plus `BottomNav` were found in source.
- 2026-11-16 requirement: pre/during/post-flood popups select "property management area" and "warning item"; list header shows selected values; popup style follows provided HTML.

## Build And Workflow
- Each task uses one git worktree (no node_modules, junction to main repo); verify, merge `dev`, and clean; `worktree-snapshot` isolates before commit and `submodule-commit` commits/pushes; background build exit 0 produces `dist`.
- Default `bun run build demo` uses seed data when `usePortalApi()` is false; remote `uni build -m test` uses `.env.test`; project uses bun, has no ESLint CLI, Vitest covers `tests/**/*.test.ts`, and remote mock requests lock `bizState→status` mapping.
- Pitfalls: import `onShow` from `@dcloudio/uni-app` (from `vue` gives TS2305); browser needs a hash query to bypass old lazy chunks (`pages-home-index.*.js`); hash changes do not trigger `onShow`; role switch needs full reload; `store/user.ts`, `utils/index.ts`, and `responseDecrypt.ts` type errors are pre-existing.
- 2026-11-25 build and unit tests passed, then deployment panel and dual-account verification; fixed `dist` was deployed to the test site. 2026-11-24 rescue detail issue involved `raw:true` not unwrapped plus logs/region field-name mismatch; fix plan approved (see "Rescue work order detail"), local preview `localhost:8162` read `dist` directly, and 2026-11-25 pointed to freshly built `dist`.

## API And Deployment
- `usePortalApi()` requests lists only when API base is non-empty and token exists; preview build sets `VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api` and intercepts responses; deployment must set `VITE_API_BASE_URL` or `VITE_AUTH_BASE_URL`; learning/news come from fixtures and field mapping is unverified by real API.
- `request(..., {raw:true})` returns `{code,msg,data}` for caller unwrap, while default unwraps data; `portal.ts detail()` unwraps; `GET /v2.0/system/region/list(parentCode=320500)` is login-free and returns `JsonResult<List<SysRegionVo>>` with `{regionName,regionCode,level,parentCode}`; 2026-11-11 added `getKeyData/getBenefitData/getRepairData/getSunshineOverview/getRegionList` in the same pattern.
- nginx uses port 8095 upstream `192.168.1.31`; local backend changes usually do not affect real-device verification; local backend `mvn compile` needs sibling API jars `zhi2-property-api` and `common-framework-api` installed in the local Maven repo.

# ZenTao Bug 7043
ZenTao bug 7043 is a flood-control big-screen heatmap defect where selecting Gusu District causes heat to overflow beyond administrative boundaries; as of 2026-11-27 the clip rework failed real-machine verification and remained unsubmitted, unpushed, and not written back to ZenTao.

## Ticket And Symptoms
- Link: http://zentao-biz.zhi.com/index.php?m=bug&f=view&bugID=7043; type=Page, severity 4, opened by lichandan, assigned to tiany, status active.
- Symptom: selecting "姑苏区(全区)" draws the red heat circle across the Gusu boundary into Huqiu, Xiangcheng, and Wuzhong.
- User chose "clip heatmap to selected district boundary" and required commit/push plus ZenTao writeback.
- chain_id=bug7043-heatmap-clip; current hop was hop7; document maxHops=10 conflicts with the session P0 rule of no hop limit, so the document was followed and termination depends only on section 4 being empty.

## Root Cause And Plan
- `HeatMapPanel.vue` uses ECharts `type:'heatmap'` with `pointSize:46, blurSize:62` Gaussian diffusion, so heat is rendered by canvas rectangle rather than administrative polygon.
- The `activeDistrict` prop was passed but unused in `render()`; selecting Gusu still drew the whole city and allowed overflow.
- Plan: apply CSS `clip-path` polygon to the heatmap-only zlevel 2 canvas, computed from selected-district GeoJSON through `convertToPixel`; zlevel 2 was verified heatmap-only (geo=0, effectScatter=3, label=4).
- Gusu is a single ring with no holes; the implementation supports GeoJSON native ring direction with nonzero fill for holes and traverses all MultiPolygon outer rings.
- Plan review scored 86/100 with no P0 and sha256 `094bdaec…44bfe0d48`; its 3 P1 items were implementation details (zlevel 2 content, outer/hole handling, clip recalculation after setOption/resize), so no user question was needed.

## Implementation Status
- Completed before hop7: `HeatMapPanel.vue` clip implementation, error ledger update, eslint exit 0, `npm test` exit 0, build exit 0 in 46s (job `bash-e086e3b9db844cfc`).
- Rework plan `bug7043-heatmap-clip-rework.md` passed plan_review at 82/100 with 0 P0, was user-confirmed, and opened the plan gate.
- Rework changed `HeatMapPanel.vue` value logic (code normalization + districts watch) and `common-errors.md`; single-file/screen eslint exit 0 and `npm test` exit 0.
- The effective build was shown by `version.json` timestamp 13:22:58.
- Cumulative equivalent cost reached 1.08M across the 1.00M handoff threshold (mid, max 10 hops), then 154k in hop7, triggering P0 forced handoffs.

## Verification And Handoff
- Hop1 handoff `HANDOFF-CHAIN-bug7043-heatmap-clip-hop1-20261127-1201.md` had 9 sections with chain_id/hop/maxHops; schedule `schedule-52199989-bb5e-4dd3-a0fa-d0948fca8a2c` delivered 12:01:49 session `session-e0dc60d1` with document path, section 9, chain metadata, and goal.
- Earlier todos were real login, switch Gusu, verify no overflow, take screenshot and ask user, then commit/push only `HeatMapPanel.vue` + `common-errors.md`, ZenTao writeback with uploaded image/resolved/fixed/comment image, and job_list plus artifact cleanup; leftover job `bash-a6a99fb092174854` (browser open) was to be collected/stopped by the next hop.
- Hop7 used browser session `bug7043-e91695ee90b8` at `http://localhost:8165/#/safety/flood/floodScreen`; opening the flood screen redirected to login, captcha OCR was used, `7-1=6` was rejected, `2+5=7` succeeded, and the login button needed eval click because it was covered by a span.
- After hard refresh the selector showed "姑苏区（全区）" persisted; DOM had `path("M 418.14 370.66…")` on 1 of 5 canvases (index2), but magpie-vision self-check found the heat still overflowed into northwest Huqiu and south Wuzhong; suspected causes are 913×716 internal pixels vs CSS 488×383 scaling and/or clip on the wrong canvas, so hop6 rework failed acceptance.
- Hop7 evidence screenshot `gusu-clip-rework-20261127-132850.png` in `$TEMP/zentao-7043/` was retained as defect evidence; handoff `D:/plan/苏住房G/HANDOFF-CHAIN-bug7043-heatmap-clip-hop7-20261127-1329.md` was written, hop8 was scheduled for 13:30:16 within 30 seconds, section 4 remained unfinished, and no commit, push, or ZenTao writeback occurred.
